class Base<T> {
  constructor(protected value: T) {}
}
class Derived<T> extends Base<T> {
  read(other: DerivedView<T>): T { return other.value; }
  readGeneric<U extends IndirectView<T>>(other: U): T { return other.value; }
  readIntersection(other: DerivedView<T> & object): T { return other.value; }
}
interface DerivedView<T> extends Derived<T> {}
interface IndirectView<T> extends DerivedView<T> {}
const derived = new Derived(3);
console.log(derived.read(derived), derived.readGeneric(derived), derived.readIntersection(derived));
